note: Proof of work. Each entry records when a task reached a status and which commit did it. Written by `npm run log`.

entries.subject: T02: FCO vocabulary and seeded FCG with addressable nodes
entries.summary: FCO (15 node types, 20 edge types) and FCG seed: 75 nodes, 125 edges, fly tools and tardigrade capabilities

entries.subject: T03: R/Python tool nodes, git sync and proof-of-work logger
entries.summary: 17 tool nodes (Python, R, web, platforms) with install, docs and stage; npm run log and kg:sync

entries.subject: T04: hashed TF-IDF vector search over the graph, /api/kg/search
entries.summary: Vector index rebuilt on every graph change; /api/kg/search?q= ranks nodes by cosine

entries.subject: T05: shared tool registry served over MCP (/api/mcp) and REST (/api/tools, /api/kg)
entries.summary: 12 tools; MCP initialize/tools/list/tools/call verified with curl; REST node, status, worklog routes

entries.subject: T06: agent connector with one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-many routing
entries.summary: /api/connect and agent_* tools; messages are graph nodes with sentBy/sentTo/postedIn edges; all three modes verified

entries.subject: T07: chat endpoint on the Claude API with graph retrieval and tool use, /chat page
entries.summary: /api/chat: RAG context + tool loop over read-only graph tools (claude-opus-5-5, server-side fallback); offline answer when no API key; /chat UI

entries.subject: T08: built-vs-needed board, node pages, worklog timeline and agents page
entries.summary: /graph board (capabilities, pipeline, tasks, questions, tool table), /node/<type>/<slug>, /worklog plan vs actual with PT/UTC, /agents

entries.subject: T09: README, deploy notes and roadmap link for the agent connector; production build passes
entries.summary: npm run build passes (24 routes); prod server checked; README, DEPLOY env vars, roadmap page updated

entries.subject: T10: shared persistence for runtime graph additions and agent messages via Upstash Redis
entries.summary: Upstash Redis store (nodes hash + edges list); sync() before reads, flush() after writes; verified a message and node written on one server instance are read on another

entries.subject: T11: step-by-step Vercel setup for storage, chat key and read-only mode
entries.summary: docs/DEPLOY.md: import, Upstash Redis, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PLAYPEN_READONLY, redeploy, checks

entries.subject: T12: chat backend switch between frontier (Claude), local (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server) and search only
entries.summary: src/lib/llm/{claude,local,common}.ts; GET /api/chat lists backends; picker on /chat; local tool calling with fallback to context-only; tested against an OpenAI-compatible stub and in the browser

entries.subject: T20: dependency-free stress test for the API, MCP, chat and pages
entries.summary: scripts/stress.mjs: read, read+write, 20k-node bulk load via MCP; baseline showed reads 15x slower at 22k nodes
